October ★ | Post-Race | Wind: Mild Breeze 
"Made Waves, Didn't We?" 
====================

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
Shaving off time at every corner— 
Navigator-dono's strategy wasn't bad, but 
the one who claimed victory was Air 
Shakur.

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't settle the score, but making 
Air Shakur freak out makes it all right!
